_note: The Disasters category (Kevin, 2026-11-23): kind → cause → type, as in pipelines/common/event_categories.py (VOCAB 'disaster', DISASTER_TYPES). Names follow the IRDR peril classification as EM-DAT uses it: Integrated Research on Disaster Risk (2014), Peril classification and hazard glossary (IRDR DATA Publication No. 1); EM-DAT's classification tree as updated in September 2023 (https://doc.emdat.be/docs/data-structure-and-content/disaster-classification-system/, read 2026-11-23). 'emdat' gives the EM-DAT group > subgroup > type each value matches; 'note' says where we merge or rename. 'wikidata' is the matching Wikidata class (checked against Wikidata's labels, 2026-11-23). Facet values have no ids field, so the ids live here, not in the timelines.

natural.name: Natural
natural.irdr: the six natural families: geophysical, hydrological, meteorological, climatological, biological, extra-terrestrial

human-caused.name: Human-caused
human-caused.note: Renamed: EM-DAT's 'Technological' group plus famines caused by policy or war (EM-DAT's former 'Complex' group, removed in 2023), and nuclear tests, which EM-DAT doesn't record.

eruption.name: Volcanic activity
eruption.note: The id stays 'eruption' (Kevin's word); the name is EM-DAT's type.

earthquake.name: Earthquake or tsunami
earthquake.emdat: Natural > Geophysical > Earthquake (subtypes: Ground movement; Tsunami)
earthquake.note: Renamed: EM-DAT's 'Earthquake' type, named with its tsunami subtype so a reader finds tsunamis here (Kevin, 2026-11-23).

storm.name: Storm
storm.emdat: Natural > Meteorological > Storm (incl. Tropical cyclone, Tornado, Blizzard/Winter storm)

drought.name: Drought or crop failure
drought.note: Renamed and merged: EM-DAT's 'Drought', plus famines with no policy or war cause (EM-DAT reclassified most famines as drought in 2023).

famine.name: Famine
famine.emdat: none since 2023 (the former 'Complex' group; now an 'Associated disaster' tag)
famine.note: Only a famine caused mainly by policy or war (Kevin, 2026-11-23); one classed as genocide also carries 'Massacre or genocide'.

accident.name: Accident or explosion
accident.note: EM-DAT's 'Miscellaneous accident' (collapse, explosion, fire). Transport accidents (EM-DAT's 'Transport': air, rail, road, water) are not mapped yet: Kevin is weighing new types (2026-11-23).

nuclear-test.name: Nuclear test
nuclear-test.emdat: none (EM-DAT records accidents, not tests; nearest: Industrial accident > Radiation)
nuclear-test.note: Added: no IRDR or EM-DAT class (Kevin, 2026-11-23).
